comparison.position: 传统残差把原始输入和历层增量输出直接相加。DCA把这份历史保留下来，由可学习的feature×history基础权重，加上逐token、逐历史项的动态项，选择层输入；Q、K、V分别使用独立GRN-v3。这里的深度路由不是在层维做softmax，而是直接加权求和；普通attention仍在token维计算。
comparison.tradeoff: RD-AttnRes从Block AttnRes出发保留共享QK路由、单独解耦V，采用其attention-residual深度选择机制。DCA的Q/K/V三路均独立，并以feature-dependent基础权重加ReLU动态项线性求和，不是把RD的V路由复制三份。两者都改变attention输入来源，却不能互换归一化、历史缓存或完整训练证据。

analysis.title: DeepCrossAttention: Supercharging Transformer Residual Connections
analysis.body: RD-AttnRes从Block AttnRes出发保留共享QK路由、单独解耦V，采用其attention-residual深度选择机制。DCA的Q/K/V三路均独立，并以feature-dependent基础权重加ReLU动态项线性求和，不是把RD的V路由复制三份。两者都改变attention输入来源，却不能互换归一化、历史缓存或完整训练证据。 固定v2§3.1文字公式为b+ReLU(wᵀG)：b初始化为1，w初始化为0。按PyTorch的ReLU'(0)=0，精确零初始化时动态w的第一步梯度为0；本地把它作为可见负控，而不是偷偷换激活或随机初始化。Figure3还画了文字公式未明确的Norm和不同的activation次序；本地声明按文字公式解释，不声称复刻作者训练器。Figure4的Q/K/V外部Norm以三套LayerNorm实现。

question.question: DCA与RD-AttnRes的Q/K/V解耦边界有什么区别？
question.answer: RD-AttnRes保留共享QK、解耦V；DCA对Q、K、V各自配置独立GRN-v3，且深度混合公式不同。
question.example: 教学例：只修改DCA的Q基础权重，K和V路由输出必须逐位不变；RD中Q和K本来共享路由。

comparison.position: Standard residuals sum the input and previous incremental layer outputs. DCA retains that history and combines feature-by-history base weights with token/history-dependent terms. Q, K and V have independent GRN-v3 modules. Depth routing is an unnormalized weighted sum, not a layer-wise softmax; ordinary attention still operates across tokens.
comparison.tradeoff: RD-AttnRes starts from Block AttnRes, retains one QK route and separates V through its attention-residual mechanism. DCA instead separates all three Q/K/V routes and uses feature-dependent base weights plus ReLU dynamic terms in a linear sum. It is not three copies of RD's V route. Their normalization, historical storage and full-training evidence are not interchangeable.

analysis.body: RD-AttnRes starts from Block AttnRes, retains one QK route and separates V through its attention-residual mechanism. DCA instead separates all three Q/K/V routes and uses feature-dependent base weights plus ReLU dynamic terms in a linear sum. It is not three copies of RD's V route. Their normalization, historical storage and full-training evidence are not interchangeable. The fixed-v2 Section3.1 text specifies b+ReLU(wᵀG), initializing b to one and w to zero. Under PyTorch's ReLU'(0)=0 convention, the initial dynamic-w gradient is zero. We expose that negative control instead of changing activation or initialization. Figure3 additionally depicts normalization and a different activation ordering not explicit in the text equation. Local code declares the text-formula interpretation, not the authors' training implementation. Three LayerNorms follow the Q/K/V routes as in Figure4.

question.question: How does DCA's Q/K/V separation differ from RD-AttnRes?
question.answer: RD-AttnRes retains shared QK routing and separates V. DCA has three independent GRN-v3 modules and a different depth-mixing formula.
question.example: Illustration: changing only DCA's Q base weights must leave K/V route outputs bitwise unchanged; RD shares the Q/K route.

comparison.position: 近等分布的真实KL是二阶小量，但教科书公式往往由一阶或常数量相减得到，容易返回零、负数或错误梯度。StableKL把闭式KL重写成非负小量的组合，配合差值、补偿算术和解析梯度；它还区分F.kl_div算子误差与输入log-prob本身已丢失的信息。本地只选择其中Exponential族的Rewrite核。
comparison.tradeoff: 随机舍入处理的是FP32小更新转BF16时落回同一格点，靠随机相邻格点在条件期望上保留变化。StableKL处理的是已存参数上的确定性代数消去，靠公式重写与解析梯度减少误差。前者不修复错误KL公式，后者也不能恢复输入量化前已经消失的更新；提高precision、clamp和随机舍入都不是可互换的补丁。

analysis.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
analysis.body: 随机舍入处理的是FP32小更新转BF16时落回同一格点，靠随机相邻格点在条件期望上保留变化。StableKL处理的是已存参数上的确定性代数消去，靠公式重写与解析梯度减少误差。前者不修复错误KL公式，后者也不能恢复输入量化前已经消失的更新；提高precision、clamp和随机舍入都不是可互换的补丁。 Exponential的x先由原始rate之差计算，避免先取ratio再减1。在−0.75≤x≤3上，FP32用K=17的Horner级数计算φ；两侧使用条件良好的log1p或log(rate_q/rate_p)分支。自定义autograd直接返回两rate解析导数。末端非负截断只是稳定公式的边界约定，不是对原始消去公式clamp就算修复。原文strict模式、区间算术与其他分布的误差自由变换不在本地范围。

question.question: StableKL与随机舍入能互相替代吗？
question.answer: 不能。随机舍入解决量化格点吞掉更新，并引入受控随机性；StableKL解决已存输入上的确定性消去。丢失在输入表示中的信息也不属于KL算子能恢复的范围。
question.example: 教学例：BF16把两个rate先都存成1，StableKL只能正确给0；若FP32仍保留两者差值，它才可通过重写恢复小的正KL。

comparison.position: For nearby distributions, true KL is second order, while textbook formulas subtract first-order or constant terms. They can return zero, negative values or inaccurate gradients. StableKL uses nonnegative decompositions, accurate differences, compensated arithmetic and analytic gradients, distinguishing operator error from information already lost in rounded log-probabilities. Local code covers only the Exponential Rewrite core.
comparison.tradeoff: Stochastic rounding addresses FP32 updates disappearing on conversion to the BF16 grid, preserving changes in conditional expectation through randomized adjacent values. StableKL addresses deterministic algebraic cancellation on already stored parameters through formula rewrites and analytic gradients. The former does not repair KL algebra; the latter cannot recover an update lost before input storage. Precision promotion, clamping and stochastic rounding are not interchangeable patches.

analysis.title: The KL Divergence Is Never Negative, Except in PyTorch
analysis.body: Stochastic rounding addresses FP32 updates disappearing on conversion to the BF16 grid, preserving changes in conditional expectation through randomized adjacent values. StableKL addresses deterministic algebraic cancellation on already stored parameters through formula rewrites and analytic gradients. The former does not repair KL algebra; the latter cannot recover an update lost before input storage. Precision promotion, clamping and stochastic rounding are not interchangeable patches. The Exponential argument is formed from the raw rate difference before division, not ratio-minus-one. On−0.75≤x≤3, FP32 uses a17-term Horner series for phi. Outside it, well-conditioned log1p or log(rate_q/rate_p) branches are used. Custom autograd returns analytic gradients for both rates. A final nonnegative clamp is a boundary convention of the stable formula, not a repair obtained by clamping the cancelling textbook formula. Strict mode, interval arithmetic and error-free transformations for other families are absent.

question.question: Can StableKL and stochastic rounding replace one another?
question.answer: No. Stochastic rounding addresses updates lost to a quantization grid; StableKL addresses deterministic cancellation on stored inputs. Information already lost in the input representation cannot be restored by the KL operator.
question.example: Illustration: if BF16 first stores both rates as1, StableKL correctly returns0. If FP32 retains their difference, rewriting can recover the small positive KL.
